text: Sixty-four cacao farmers are paid from handwritten weigh-slips. A duplicate
copy, or a fine no rule allows, goes unseen. Members can't check their pay,
and the buyer can't prove its premium arrived.
Fair Split: Claude reads the paper. Code computes every amount and holds
what it can't justify. Two officers sign. PayPal pays, on a simulated
sandbox; cash members get the same statement. The brand re-checks it all.
Slips go to Claude, then a deterministic engine. Two keys sign the batch
hash. A transactional outbox makes each PayPal call idempotent, against an
in-process simulator whose signed webhooks we verify.
What's special: a split matrix that rebalances, a mass-balance dial, a rate
card that refuses edits, two keys, browser-side proof, audio statements, and
Try to break it.
Each delivery gets a handwritten slip and a pink carbon copy. Photograph
both, and it counts twice.
Lantern Bay funds the season with one invoice, through PayPal's Agent
Toolkit on a simulated sandbox.
Here is Claude's real reading of one slip. The run itself replays a labelled
stand-in; Analyn enters a stained digit by hand.
Count it once: the duplicate claim returns to sixty-three members, the grid
rebalances, and the dial drops inside the limit.
Two more holds, decided in ink. Then Analyn tries adding a deduction.
Refused: the rate card was hashed before the first slip.
Above three hundred dollars, two keys: Analyn holds to sign; the Chair
co-signs the same batch hash on his phone.
The simulated PayPal accepts the batch: sent, not yet paid. Seven items
confirm; a member without PayPal moves to cash.
Lantern Bay opens Proof and re-checks the rate card, both signatures and
every line, in its own browser.
A member taps a peso; it traces to her slips.
Premium gikan sa Lantern Bay Chocolate Co.: forty-three dollars and
sixty-nine cents, walay kaltas.
Underneath: more than five thousand automated tests, idempotent PayPal
calls, verified simulator webhooks, three kill switches, and replays always
labelled.
The limits: PayPal runs on a simulated sandbox. People and data are
synthetic; no real farmer was paid. Judge runs replay a labelled reading
stand-in. Voices are Gemini TTS.
Members check their own pay; the brand traces its premium. Every peso,
traced to the pencil mark.
